descriptionHtml:
Step into sophistication with our Flowy Plus Size Halter Neck Chiffon Midi Wedding Guest Dress. This elegant dress features a chic halter neckline and a flowy chiffon fabric that drapes beautifully. The midi length and flattering fit make it perfect for curvy figures, ensuring comfort and style at wedding celebrations. Elevate your look with this stunning dress designed to make you feel confident and graceful.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi Length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
